title: Network, Temple and Wildheart profile kits carry a Services page where the main page leads with something else
detail: Profile kits whose main page leads with events, classes, meetups or chapters now also get a `services` page: a short lead, the Space's offerings, and an Ask us contact block. Niches whose main page already is the offerings page skip it. Nocturne (the midnight id) is left to the Nocturne design-system thread.

verify.evidence: profile-variants.ts adds a services page to Network, Temple and Wildheart.
verify.cmd: node -e 'const t=require("fs").readFileSync("lib/sites/kits/profile-variants.ts","utf8");if((t.match(/\.\.\.services\(spec\)/g)||[]).length<3){console.error("a profile kit lost its Services page");process.exit(1)}'
